name: Photonic Devices
description: Review of semiconductor physics for photonics: the density of states ρ(k) and ρ(e) in low dimension structures; semiconductor optoelectronic materials; heterostructures, strained-layers, bandgap engineering; epitaxial growth of heterostructure for targeted lasers, p-n junctions; Schottky junctions and ohmic contact. Interaction of photons with electrons and holes in a semiconductor; the semiconductor optical amplifier; quantum confined stark effect and Franz-Keldysh effect, photo-Dember effect light emitting diode: device structure and output characteristics, modulation bandwidth, materials for LED, and applications. Quantum well and quantum cascade laser, semiconductor laser diode, double heterostructure lasers, photonic crystal based microcavity lasers. Photodetectors: general characteristics of photodetectors, photoconductors for ultrafast applications, PIN, APD, array detectors, photonic switches and optical gates.
